displayName: OCI-AI-DB-005: AI — RAG Context Window Injection
description:
Detects injection of malicious context into RAG retrieved documents that overrides model behavior

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_db_005", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%rag%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%context%') AND "value" > 0
